decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf fits the bakery's core business and needs little extra resource, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search, so the firm keeps it.

The historic mill tour is a low-cost heritage offering that builds the brand and draws customers, so with modest slack and no reported shortfall the firm can keep carrying it despite its uncertain direct returns.
A sweet pastry is a standard bakery line extension, and since no performance problems were reported, results are presumably near aspiration and the firm keeps it.
